facts.text: Thayumanaswami Pillai died on May 9, 1935 leaving two widows respondent 2 Mangayarkarasi Ammal and respondent 3 Kanniammal and widowed daughter respondent 4 Pichai Ammal

anchor.surface_text: During his lifetime the testator was a member of a joint and undivided Hindu family consisting of himself and his son, Thayumanaswami Pillai. Neither of them had any son.
